english.title: Use a Midland Metro ticket / travel pass / official authority unlawfully sold / purchased / transferred / received
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly used or attempted to use

(A)_[a ticket]_
(B)_[a travel pass]_
(C)_[an official authority]_

to travel on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), which had been

(D)_[sold]_
(E)_[purchased]_
(F)_[transferred]_
(G)_[received]_

in contravention of byelaw 4(7) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 in that **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(7) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989
